Subject: Re: Fwd: Promo code applied but credit balance shows 0 — grant missing from ledger

Thanks for the ping — I pulled the logs. The signup-service emitted the grant request but the ledger-worker returned a 409 for an existing transaction id (dup handling), and the idempotency key wasn't stored due to a race during retries. That left the grant in a limbo state (frontend showed success because the request to coupon service returned OK, but ledger never persisted).

Short-term fix: I can run a backfill script to insert the missing ledger entry for canvas-labs and mark the idempotency key so future retries are safe. That will take ~20–30 minutes to run and I'll validate by hitting the public credits endpoint.

Long-term: I'll add a guard in the ledger-worker to persist idempotency key before making the external grant-write call and add a reconciliation job to pick up half-applied grants every 15 minutes.

I'll proceed with the backfill if I get a thumbs-up.

- Dev
Engineering
Redwood Inference
